bullets.text: \textbf{iOS App Development:} Delivered Free Parking feature for billing adjustments and resolved production issues on-call.

\textbf{Architecture Leadership \& AI Development:} Used Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot with \textbf{Context Engineering} to drive architectural decisions and accelerate migration across MVVM and Clean Architecture patterns.

\textbf{AI-Driven Productivity:} Leveraged AI for \textbf{code reviews}, automated \textbf{test case generation} (XCTest / XCUITest), and systematic debugging via \textbf{structured logging}, improving velocity and solution quality.

\textbf{High-Scale Engineering:} Maintained a \textbf{30+ lakh DAU} consumer app sustaining \textbf{99.95\%+ crash-free sessions} under peak load via Firebase Crashlytics triage and structured crash workflows.

\textbf{LE Bottom Sheet:} Led end-to-end delivery of a lightweight event-overview component reducing full-screen navigations for 30\%+ of user flows; collaborated across PM, Design, and Backend on API contracts.

\textbf{Ads Module (Revenue-Critical):} Refactored the highest-revenue module; added \textbf{pause/play lifecycle} for video ads inside a reusable \textbf{HeroWidget}. Used \textbf{POP + Generics} for a type-safe rendering pipeline.

\textbf{Payment Processing-Time Popup:} Designed and shipped a lightweight popup surfacing real-time payment/booking processing status to reduce user drop-off and support queries during checkout delays.
\textbf{Firebase Performance Traces:} Instrumented p50/p90 latency across listing, checkout, and search journeys, forming an observability layer for data-driven optimisation across releases.
\textbf{Concurrency Safety:} Introduced \textbf{synchronised dictionaries} via GCD serial queues and read-write locks to eliminate race conditions and concurrent-access crashes in shared async state.

\textbf{Backend-Driven Header \& Search:} Migrated the app header to a \textbf{generalised, protocol-driven} main-screen implementation; modernised search with debouncing, state indication, and MVVM alignment.
\textbf{Security \& Performance:} Migrated Ads pod from Alamofire to \textbf{URLSession}. Enforced \textbf{HTTPS} and \textbf{SSL pinning with domain whitelisting} to mitigate MITM attacks.

\textbf{CI/CD \& Release Automation:} Set up \textbf{automated GitHub Actions} pipelines for build, lint, and \textbf{TestFlight} distribution, cutting manual release overhead; used \textbf{AI-assisted PR reviews} (Copilot/Claude) to catch regressions before merge.
\textbf{Incident Management (IMOC):} Coordinated iOS, backend, and QA teams to triage and resolve \textbf{P0/P1 incidents}, minimising downtime during high-traffic events.

\textbf{Multi-App Ownership (NBA/WNBA):} Built and maintained production iOS apps for \textbf{Memphis Grizzlies, Miami Heat, Las Vegas Aces, and Chicago Sky} serving hundreds of thousands of sports fans.

\textbf{Memphis Grizzlies} \textit{(SwiftUI, UIKit, Deeplinks, Mixpanel, Airship):} Architected key UI with \textbf{SwiftUI+UIKit interoperability}, deep linking, navigation flows, and application lifecycle handling. Integrated \textbf{Mixpanel} and \textbf{Airship} for analytics and push notifications.

\textbf{Miami Heat \& Stories SDK} \textit{(SwiftUI, Live Updates):} Designed and shipped a \textbf{standalone reusable Stories SDK} for Instagram-style fan content, adopted across the client portfolio. Managed the \textbf{live in-arena scoreboard}.
\textbf{Las Vegas Aces} \textit{(UIKit, Deeplinks):} Integrated \textbf{audio streaming} for live broadcasts; revamped splash screen with server-driven content reducing cold-start latency.
\textbf{Chicago Sky -- Migration} \textit{(UIKit, TicketMaster, SDKs):} Led \textbf{Xcode 15 migration}, resolving breaking SDK and deprecated API changes with a QA-driven, zero-regression checklist.

projects.name: FinTrack -- On-Device AI Expense Tracker
projects.stack: Flutter, Dart, Hive, BM25 RAG, Apple Intelligence, Gemini Nano
bullets: Built a \textbf{privacy-first, local-first} Flutter expense tracker (Android/iOS) with offline Hive storage and biometric app lock; \textbf{no cloud sync of financial data}.

Designed an \textbf{on-device AI Savings Coach}: custom \texttt{flutter\_native\_ai} plugin bridging Flutter to \textbf{Apple Foundation Models} (iOS) and \textbf{Gemini Nano / ML Kit Prompt API} (Android) via Pigeon, with a \textbf{BM25 offline RAG retriever} over the user's local spending index and a deterministic rule-based fallback for unsupported devices.
Shipped production ops: Firebase Crashlytics, Remote Config-driven force/optional updates, and AdMob monetisation -- app released on the Play Store.

projects.name: GymFlow -- Gym Operations Platform
bullets: Architected a multi-role B2B platform (Owner/Staff/Trainer/Member) on one \textbf{NestJS + Prisma} API serving a \textbf{Next.js} staff portal and a single \textbf{Flutter} member/trainer app with role-based navigation.

Implemented secure attendance: geofenced QR check-in plus an \textbf{HMAC-SHA1 rotating TOTP} desk bypass (30s rotation), membership gating, memberships/payments, and lead/WhatsApp follow-up workflows.

Built an \textbf{on-device workout recommender}: INT8-quantised \textbf{MiniLM (TFLite)} embeddings with a Dart WordPiece tokenizer for cosine-similarity retrieval over the exercise catalog, using the trainer's routine as \textbf{RAG context}, with a fail-soft TF-IDF fallback -- no cloud LLM dependency.

projects.name: BookMyShow
projects.stack: UIKit, SwiftUI, MVVM, Backend-Driven UI, Firebase, SSL Pinning
bullets: Scaled to \textbf{30+ lakh DAU}; \textbf{99.95\%+ crash-free sessions}. Owned Ads Module, LE Bottom Sheet, backend-driven header, search modernisation, SSL pinning, and synchronised dictionaries end-to-end.

architectureExpertise.text: \textbf{Design Patterns:} Expert in \textbf{MVVM, MVC, MVI (Model-View-Intent), and Clean Architecture} (View / ViewModel / Domain / Data separation). Experienced migrating legacy codebases with zero-regression delivery.

\textbf{Protocol-Oriented \& Generic Programming:} Extensive use of \textbf{Swift Protocols, Generics, and associated types} for composable, type-safe components across ad pipelines, form systems, and SDK interfaces.

\textbf{On-Device AI \& Edge ML:} Designed \textbf{offline RAG pipelines} (BM25 and embedding-based cosine retrieval), integrated \textbf{TFLite}, \textbf{Apple Intelligence}, and \textbf{Gemini Nano} for on-device inference with fail-soft, rule-based fallbacks -- privacy-first, zero cloud-LLM dependency.

\textbf{Cross-Platform Development:} Built and shipped production \textbf{Flutter/Dart} apps (feature-first Clean Architecture, Provider state management) alongside native \textbf{Swift/SwiftUI} apps, sharing one backend API across platforms.

\textbf{iOS Platform Expertise:} Strong understanding of Apple's application lifecycle, deep linking, push notification lifecycle, Human Interface Guidelines (HIG), adaptive layouts, accessibility, and responsive UI design.

\textbf{Server-Driven UI (SDUI) \& CMS Integration:} Designed and consumed \textbf{SDUI} systems -- headers, search, banners -- fully controlled by \textbf{CMS}-managed content and remote configuration, decoupling client releases from layout and content changes.

\textbf{Concurrency \& Thread Safety:} \textbf{GCD, OperationQueue, async/await, Combine, and actor isolation}. Eliminated data races with synchronised dictionaries and read-write lock patterns in production.

\textbf{Context \& Prompt Engineering:} Structured \textbf{Context Engineering} and \textbf{Prompt Engineering} with Cursor, Claude, and Copilot to produce architecturally sound, review-ready code at accelerated velocity across Swift and Flutter codebases.
